cards.name: coffee30 v2 女主手机（未发送的消息）

prop.shape: modern smartphone with dark unlit screen, thin matte body
prop.material: matte glass and aluminium body, dark screen with soft reflections only
prop.style_lock: contemporary minimal, no case, no stickers

state_timeline.state: picked up from the bed, held in her right hand, dark screen
state_timeline.motivation: 她以为他一声不响走了，打字想质问

state_timeline.state: set face-down on the duvet beside her knee
state_timeline.motivation: 读到便签后先把手机扣下再拿起便签

state_timeline.state: back in her right hand, unsent line deleted, one short reply sent

prompt_fragments.material_lock_text: matte glass phone body, dark unlit screen with soft window reflections

continuity_rules: phone stays within her right-hand reach until she sets it face-down in N7

cards.name: coffee30 v2 床头咖啡杯

prop.shape: ceramic coffee cup, nearly full, on the light wooden nightstand
prop.material: matte ceramic surface, thin steam, a warm condensation ring on the wood
prop.ratio: standard cup, two hands can wrap it
prop.style_lock: quiet daily ceramic, no printed pattern, no logo

state_timeline.state: placed on the nightstand, full, steaming, note tucked under the rim
state_timeline.motivation: 他早起为她做好并轻轻放下

state_timeline.state: lifted in both her hands, first sip
back on the nightstand in morning light, final frame anchor

prompt_fragments.material_lock_text: matte ceramic cup, thin rising steam, warm condensation ring on wood

continuity_rules: cup stays on the nightstand from N1 until she lifts it in N8
